title: Multilingual Retrieval Augmented Generation for Culturally-Sensitive Tasks: A Benchmark for Cross-lingual Robustness

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in an LLM's multiple-choice answers to territorial dispute questions when prompted in different languages. This is quantified using a Delta Concurrence Score (Δ CS) that compares responses in the claimant's language versus non-claimant languages.

Analyzing the retrieval, inclusion, and citation rates of documents across 49 languages to determine if Information Retrieval (IR) systems and LLMs exhibit a preference for retrieving or citing documents in the query language or in English, particularly evaluating disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.
